newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria National Bank calls for 3 pct 2-week repos.
newsitem.headline: Austria National Bank calls for 3 pct 2-week repos.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank called for bids on Thursday on two-week securities repurchase agreements at a steady rate of three percent and said it was leaving its key interest rates unchanged.
Repo bids have to be in by 0800 GMT on Friday.
Last week the central bank allotted 15.75 billion schillings in repos, filling 16 percent of bids.
Austria's discount rate is 2.5 percent, the Lombard emergency borrowing rate 4.75 percent and the Gomex money market rate 3.4 percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +43- 531 12 254
